corrections.reason: 4th order ቃ in 'ቃሉ' (the word/expression) was misread as 2nd order ቁ ('ቁሉ').
Traditional Amharic pair 'ገረድ ደንገጡር' (maidservant and attendant) was misread as 'ገራድ ደንገጽር' due to vowel-order and multi-legged glyph confusion (ረ -> ራ, ጡ -> ጽ).
1st order ከ in the temporal clause 'ከበቁ በኋላ' (after the saints attained perfection) was misread as 6th order ክ.
4th order ያ in 'ያውቅላቸው ዘንድ' (so that people may know of them) was misread as 6th order ይ.
Canonical Ge'ez Matthew 6:16 'አማን እብለክሙ ነሥኡ ዕስቶሙ' had 6th order ን misread as ነ and 6th order ስ corrupted into an Arabic character.
Canonical Ge'ez Matthew 6:18 adverb 'ክህደ' (openly/manifestly, in 'የዓሥየክሙ ክህደ') was misread as 'ክሀት'.
The converb 'ሽሻችሁ' (having fled/shunned the crowd, 'ጉባኤውን ሽሻችሁ ተሰውራችሁ') had 6th order ሽ misread as ከ.
